content.introduction: Today's news on NVIDIA stock ahead of hyperscale earnings highlights that NVIDIA stock reached a new all-time high following months of consolidation. This positive price action is attributed to the release of GPT-5.5 by OpenAI, which committed to deploying 10 GW of NVIDIA systems, and Intel's positive earnings. The upcoming hyperscale earnings on April 29, 2026, from Alphabet, Amazon, Meta, and Microsoft are expected to significantly impact NVIDIA stock due to their AI strategies and CapEx guidance. Additionally, TSMC's raised forecast for the global semiconductor market to exceed $1.5 trillion by 2030 and Foxconn's strong earnings projecting doubled AI rack shipments this year further bolster the positive outlook for NVIDIA. The sources also mention upcoming events, including NVIDIA's earnings on May 20, 2026, and a GTC keynote from CEO Jensen Huang on June 1, 2026.
